service-guide.title: Service guide
service-guide.subtitle: Everything you need to know before you submit a request.
service-guide.step-1-body: Sign in to the portal, or create an account if you do not have one.
service-guide.step-2-body: Choose the request type and enter the details it asks for.
service-guide.step-3-body: Upload the documents listed above. You can replace a file before you submit.
service-guide.step-4-body: Check your details, then submit. You receive a reference number at once.
service-guide.step-5-body: Track its status at any time and answer any question the team sends you.
service-guide.help-body: Most questions are answered in the FAQ. If yours is not, send us a message.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Quick answers to the questions we hear most.
faq.search-placeholder: Type a word, for example: request
faq.no-results: No question matches your search. Try another word, or contact us.
faq.about-question: What can I do on this portal?
faq.about-answer: You can read about the service, submit a request online, follow its progress and contact the team.
faq.fee-question: Is there a fee to submit a request?
faq.fee-answer: Submitting a request on the portal is free. If a request type has a fee, the form tells you before you submit.
faq.language-question: Can I use the portal in English?
faq.language-answer: Yes. Switch between Arabic and English at any time with the language button at the top of the page.
faq.account-question: How do I get an account?
faq.account-answer: Choose Sign in at the top of the page. If you have no account yet, follow the steps to create one.
faq.password-question: I forgot my password. What should I do?
faq.password-answer: On the sign-in page, follow the password reset link. If you still cannot sign in, contact us.
faq.track-question: How do I follow my request?
faq.track-answer: Sign in and open your requests. Each request shows its current status and its history.
faq.returned-question: Why was my request returned to me?
faq.returned-answer: A request is returned when information or a document is missing. Read the reason, update the request and submit it again.
faq.duration-question: How long does a decision take?
faq.duration-answer: Most requests are decided within a few working days. The status page shows the expected date for your request.
faq.help-body: Send us your question and we will reply by email.
